verdict.rationale: Inngest documents an official CLI for inspecting runs, fetching traces, invoking functions, and giving coding agents access to Inngest data from the terminal. A first-party guide also covers debugging failed runs entirely from the CLI, and a probe confirms the CLI docs page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, and documentation of agent-friendly details such as machine-readable output, install, and auth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Inspect runs, fetch traces, invoke functions, and give coding agents access to your Inngest data from the terminal.
You do this entirely from the terminal using the Inngest CLI.
